__comment: The raw materials crate (doc 294, concept A, the log crib): two courses of notched logs crossing at the corners, open on top, within its 2 x 2 footprint. Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs.
Carpenters make it at the carpenter's bench from two matching logs; it keeps their wood. It stands on the floor, and dwarves reach into it from any side.

storage (ContainerStorageComponent): it holds Rough Stone, the ores and coal, and soil (stockpile_stone, stockpile_ore, stockpile_soil), three goods to each of its four quarters (per_slot), starting at priority 4, ahead of ground storage. The anchors are its quarters' places on the ground inside it (X and Z 6 cells from its centre), in footprint-local blocks from the back-left floor corner; each filled quarter shows one of its goods over the rim.
description: Two courses of notched logs crossing at the corners, open on top. It keeps twelve raw goods, Rough Stone, ore, coal or soil, three to each quarter.
